messages.subject: No success updating dartR new version 1.8.3
parts:
Dears Bearn, Arthur:
I haven't had success updating the last version of dartR.
Following:

> library(devtools)

> install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR")

Let this error message:

______________________________________________________________________________________

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘data.table’ in library.dynam(lib, package, package.lib):

shared object ‘datatable.so’ not found

Error: loading failed

Execution halted

ERROR: loading failed

* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.6/Resources/library/data.table’

* restoring previous ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.6/Resources/library/data.table’

ERROR: loading failed

Error: Failed to install 'dartR' from GitHub:

  (converted from warning) installation of package ‘data.table’ had non-zero exit status

______________________________________________________________________________________

My version that works currently is 

> packageVersion("dartR")

[1] ‘1.1.11’

Any suggestion will be welcomed.

Thanks.

Peco

messages.author: b3d929c6746ca81a
messages.subject: RE: [dartR] No success updating dartR new version 1.8.3
parts:
Hi Peco,

 

Can you try

 

install.packages(‘dartR’)

 

instead. Should work as well.

 

Also can you let me know some more details: Which system (windows, mac, linux) and which version of R you are using

 

Type:

Rversion

 

Into the console.

 

The error code sounds like the package data.table is not loading. Maybe try to reinstall package data.table as well.

 

 

install.packages(‘data.table‘, dependencies=TRUE)

 

 

 

Cheers, Bernd
